data.gender_notes: Himmah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A strong and persistent longing or craving for something, often for something that is not easily attainable. It represents the fuel that drives us towards our goals and aspirations. The name Himmah carries the meaning “Desire, Motivation, Determination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Himmah usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, motivation, determination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A deep inner yearning and commitment to fulfilling one's purpose and connecting with the divine.
data.etymology: Himmah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Motivation, Determination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Himmah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

In Islamic tradition, Himmah is considered a desirable trait for individuals to possess, as it enables them to overcome obstacles and achieve their goals. It is also associated with the concept of perseverance and determination.
